description: This Java test class 'SimpleCriteriaIT' contains integration tests for search persistence functionality within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests querying methods on 'criteria' objects to retrieve 'ThingId' objects based on attribute filters, including equality and inequality conditions. The tests set up specific 'Thing' instances with known attributes and verify that search results match expectations.

classes.name: SimpleCriteriaIT
classes.description: A final class extending 'AbstractReadPersistenceITBase', containing setup methods and multiple test methods to evaluate search criteria behavior in the persistence layer.

methods.name: createTestData
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test by calling 'insertThings()'.

methods.name: findAllByAnyAttribute
methods.description: Test retrieving all 'ThingId's regardless of attribute criteria.

methods.name: findAllByStringAttribute
methods.description: Test searching for 'ThingId's with a specific string attribute value.

methods.name: findAllByNumberAttribute
methods.description: Test searching for 'ThingId's with a specific numeric attribute value.

methods.name: findAllByBooleanAttribute
methods.description: Test searching for 'ThingId's with a specific boolean attribute value.

methods.name: findNeByStringAttribute
methods.description: Test retrieving 'ThingId's where string attribute does not equal a specific value.

methods.name: findNeByNumberAttribute
methods.description: Test retrieving 'ThingId's where numeric attribute does not equal a specific value.

methods.name: findNeByBooleanAttribute
methods.description: Test retrieving 'ThingId's where boolean attribute does not equal a specific value.

methods.name: insertThings
methods.description: Helper method to create and insert multiple 'Thing' instances with various attribute values for testing.
